pages.markdown:
Hirschmann Industrial Networking
Hirschmann by Belden provides industrial Ethernet switches and routers for factory automation.
Hirschmann RSP and MS series managed switches support PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and Modbus TCP.
HiVision software enables centralized monitoring, topology discovery, and alarm management.
OpenRail and eCore switches support VLAN, QoS, STP/RSTP, and port security for industrial use.
